exposure: Timely administration of systemic corticosteroids (within 1 hour)
cohort: 205 children aged <18 years presenting to the emergency department with a moderate to severe asthma exacerbation.
finding: Three in four children who presented with a moderate to severe asthma exacerbation at the emergency department did not receive systemic corticosteroids within the first hour, and prolonged administration time correlated with longer length of stay and oxygen support needs.
